name: The Man in the Iron Chains
summary: A man in Alcaz Prison asks you to recover the key to his shackles from The Questioner. He offers a reward for his freedom.

sections.title: At Alcaz Prison
sections.body: A prisoner in Alcaz Prison praises your defeat of a dragon, then asks you to free him from his ball and chain. The Questioner may still hold the key, if he has not fled or been killed. The prisoner's freedom rests on that key.

sections.title: After the Shackles
sections.body: With the shackles off, the man says he wants an inn, a shower, a shave and a suit. He also considers getting a haircut.

faq.answer: A man held in Alcaz Prison asks you to free him from his shackles.
The man is held in Alcaz Prison.
The Questioner should have the Alcaz Shackle Key if he has not fled or been killed.
He needs the Alcaz Shackle Key to be freed.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Man in the Iron Chains
